fixed.problem: L4f-left-1 (never cut): a chat read-back closed by a route other than the chat turn (Inbox Yes/No, POST /commands/:id/confirm or cancel, phone, email, a lapse) left the project header on 'Waiting for you: 1 change to confirm' and the open chat's Yes/No in place until a reload: those routes sent inbox.changed but no project.changed and no conversation event.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-selftasks-carried, run L4' > 'L4f-left-1: every close of a chat read-back (the Inbox's No and Yes, a chat No, a refused Yes) tells the screens ...'; apps/ui/test/selftasks-carried.test.tsx 'a closed chat card leaves no stale waiting header (L4f-left-1)' (UI guard cases)
fixed.how: The executor tells every close once: ExecutorOptions.onClosed gets a ClosedConfirmation {id, humanId, projectId, source, sessionId, how: yes|no|refused|expired} after confirm/cancel/answerPending (all routes) and after expirePending (timer and sweepPending). compose.ts turns it into inbox.changed, project.changed and, unless that conversation's turn is in flight, conversation.changed for the conversation the card was read back in (conversationOfCard). server.ts heardChat no longer emits for a card the turn answered. Fake daemon follows.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Open a project at Assisted, Chat tab. Type: tool: task_pause {"task":"<a task>"} (on a real model: 'pause <task>'). The header says 'Waiting for you: 1 change to confirm' and the Inbox badge shows 1. Press No: the header goes back (e.g. 'Ready: 1 task waits for your Start') and the badge goes, without a reload. Ask again, then answer the card in the Inbox in another window: the chat's Yes/No go and the header follows at once. live_check: bench walk1 after (/tmp/frbench/fix-l4-selftasks-carried/steps/01-after-1a-readback.png, 02-after-1b-after-no.png, 04-after-3c-chat-after-inbox-no.png).

fixed.problem: L4f-left-2 (never cut): a 'fix the tasks' read-back answered while a session ran nearly always said 'The tasks changed since I checked them', because its fingerprint was one hash of every task's fields; a session finishing any task voided the Yes.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-selftasks-carried, run L4' > 'L4f-left-2: a session finishes a task the set does not name between the read-back and the Yes, and the set applies'
fixed.how: Session lead decision 2026-11-23: taskListFingerprint is per task (v2|<id>=<hash of status,title,outcome,dependencies>); fixListMoved compares list membership and only the tasks the set names (namedTaskIds from the calls' NAMING_PARAMS and the card's subjects); a stored whole-list fingerprint is compared as before; a read failure counts as moved. Guards both ways: named task finished by a session refuses; a task added refuses, also after a restart (real-daemon and packages/commands/test/selftasks-carried.test.ts). ADR 0119 amended.
fixed.check_in_the_app: At Assisted with a running session, say 'fix the tasks: "Style the page" is two jobs, the layout and the colours'. While the read-back waits, let the session finish another task, then press Yes: the split is made. Ask again, and this time edit 'Style the page' on the Tasks tab before Yes: the reply is 'The tasks changed since I checked them; say "fix the tasks" to check again.' and nothing changes.

fixed.problem: L4-selftasks-120 rest (never cut): the redirect guards of task.transition and task.resume judged a note by its presence, so a note the chat model wrote kept a move off the card it should answer; after a restart the re-armed read-back was a task.transition, not the card's answer.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/selftasks-carried.test.ts 'the redirect guards judge a note by who wrote it' > the chat model's note case and 'after a restart, the read-back a model's note made of the card's answer is armed again as that answer, and its yes answers the card'
fixed.how: ownNote(ctx, note) in task.ts: a note is the person's only on onPersonsWords or a human actor; both guards use it, including on a card armed again after a restart (stored actor).
fixed.check_in_the_app: With a failed task whose card offers Try again, have chat retry it with a note it wrote (stand-in: tool: task_transition {"task":"<t>","to":"ready","note":"..."}): the read-back is the card's own 'Try again ("<t>" failed)? ...'; restart Forerunner and answer Yes: the card is answered 'Try again'. With your own note typed, the move stays a move.

new_problems: task.update's run (packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts, task.edit reason) and other task.ts reason lines use `params.note?.trim() || ...` as the change's reason whatever wrote the note, so a model-written note can stand as the change log's reason text; only the redirect guards were moved to ownNote (L4-selftasks-120). Outside the never-cut scope; worth a follow-up.

The stand-in's thoroughWhy (testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts) matches \breview\b, so a chat 'tool:' line whose JSON names review.md goes to answer_thoroughly instead of the tool; bench walks must avoid the word (walk2 used gaps.md).

At Assisted, chat's task_create acts at once with no read-back unless a record was read in the turn (bench walk2); this matches d1109-chat-guard's rule but means the reviewer line shows in the done sentence, not a read-back, in the common case.
notes_for_other_areas: ExecutorOptions.onClosed(ClosedConfirmation {id, humanId, projectId, source, sessionId, how: yes|no|refused|expired}) fires once for every close of a pending confirmation, from any route and on expiry; compose.ts emits inbox.changed, project.changed and conversation.changed (unless that conversation's turn is in flight). Do not emit for closed cards in route handlers again.
conversationOfCard(card) in runtime/conversation/transcript.ts names the conversation a card was read back in.
Fix sets: taskListFingerprint is now 'v2|<id>=<hash>,...'; use fixListMoved(store, projectId, print, namedTaskIds(calls, shown)) to judge a Yes; old whole-list prints still compare whole.
ChangeLogView.byYouAndAgent (GET /changes) marks rows by the person and the agent together (author_human + author_agent via record()'s alsoPerson).

CommandPorts.modelSettings.writesNoFile(specialist) and registry/tools.ts writesNoFileLine(specialist, file) + fileTheWordsWrite(words) give the reviewer line naming the file; GET /settings/models takes ?title=&outcome=&criteria=.
UI store/context.tsx: on SSE, open chats reload only on conversation.changed; in polling mode only when the Inbox count moved.
Stand-in: a tool result containing 'Write nothing about it' gets '[stand-in model]' alone; the critic accepts a writes-no-file specialist on its report.
pnpm docs:check in a worktree needs --base <branch> or DOCS_CHECK_BASE; without it says nothing was checked.
